groups.name: NASDAQ SETUP
groups.label: Mixed / Neutral
groups.explanation:
Treasury yields remain the main pressure point, with the 2Y at 4.607% and the 10Y at 4.892%. Semiconductor momentum remains an important equity confirmation: SOXX has risen for 2 consecutive sessions. QQQ is -0.26% over five sessions and -4.00% versus its 20-day average. Brent is -1.38% at about $91.29, providing some inflation relief.

The Nasdaq Setup is mixed/neutral (-14/100, 55% confidence, deteriorating ↓). The current balance is persistent semiconductor momentum, healthy market breadth, falling oil on the supportive side versus elevated/rising Treasury yields, semiconductor/AI leaders trading below their earnings AVWAPs as the main headwind.

The key confirmation remains the interaction between Treasury yields and semiconductor leadership. A sustained 10Y break above roughly 5.00–5.05% alongside weakening chips would materially weaken the setup; easing yields with stronger semiconductor participation would improve it.
